mapper.insert: insert into drugs values (null,#{img}, #{drugId}, #{typeId}, #{name}, #{price}, #{quantity}, #{specifications}, #{usage1}, #{dosage}, #{manufacturer}, #{expirationDate}, #{symptoms}, #{notes}, now(), now())
mapper.update:
update drugs
drug_name = #{name},
price = #{price},
quantity = #{quantity},
specifications = #{specifications},
`type` = #{type},
usage1 = #{usage1},
dosage = #{dosage},
manufacturer = #{manufacturer},
expiration_date = #{expirationDate},
symptoms = #{symptoms},
notes = #{notes},
update_time = now()
where drug_id = #{drugId}
mapper.select:
select count(*) from drugs join drugs_relation d on drugs.type_id = d.type_id
AND drugs.drug_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%') and d.relation_type = 1
AND d.type_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{type}, '%') and d.relation_type = 1
AND drugs.drug_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{id}, '%')
and drugs.create_time between #{startTime} and #{endTime}
